title: Global Markets Brief — 19 Nov 2026
intro: Global markets are navigating a mixed Asian session with persistent defensive positioning across European and US equities following recent weekly losses. The primary driver is geopolitical reconfiguration headlined by high-stakes diplomacy alongside massive mega-cap technology liquidity events.

sections.heading: 🌍 Macro tone
sections.content: Risk sentiment remains fractured as Asian bourses trade mixed alongside heavy Wall Street and European sessions last seen in the red. The overarching catalyst centers on shifting geopolitical alignments intersecting with heavy corporate AI deployment and record public listings.

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content: WTI trades higher at 82.46 with a 0.18 percent gain on the day, while Brent stands at 89.60 following a 2.56 percent decline. The crude complex reflects tightening regional spreads with the Brent-WTI spread narrowing to 7.14 amid shifting global supply dynamics.

sections.heading: Cross-asset read
sections.content: US 10Y yields ease 3.7bp to 5.066 percent while DXY holds near 103.80, keeping equities under pressure as the Dow drops 1.11 percent while Nasdaq 100 adds 0.42 percent. Meanwhile, VIX remains elevated at 24.56, showing lingering defensive demand across asset classes.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Escalating geopolitical tensions overshadowing upcoming US economic data releases.
- Spillover volatility from European and Asian equity sell-offs into US trading hours.
